# ship-sessions

Your interface to the `sessions` ops. Invoke each over ConnectRPC:

```
ship ops call <name> --json '<args-json>'
```

Reads are safe (C0). Commands carry a blast-radius class. Open an op's reference
page for full args, return shape, capability, and an example.

## Reads

- [`sessions.list`](references/docs/sessions.list.mdoc) — All live PTY sessions (agent chats, pipeline runs, shells) — Mission Control data.
